items.text: Laba yibo abeza kuDavide eSikilagi esamlindile ngenxa kaSawule indodana kaKishi; futhi babephakathi kwamaqhawe, abasizi bempi.
Babehlome ngeminsalo, besebenzisa isandla sokunene nesokhohlo ukujikijela amatshe nemicibisholo ngomnsalo, bephuma kubafowabo bakaSawule bakwaBenjamini.
Induna yayinguAhiyezeri, noJowashi, amadodana kaShemaha waseGibeya; noJesiyeli noPheleti, amadodana ka-Ashimaweti; noBeraga noJehu umAntoti;
no-Ishmaya waseGibeyoni, iqhawe phakathi kwamashumi amathathu namashumi amathathu; noJeremiya, noJagasiyeli, noJohanani, noJozabadi waseGedera,
u-Eluzayi, noJerimoti, noBheliya, noShemariya, noShefathiya umHarufi;
u-Elkana, noJesiya, no-Azareli, noJoweri, noJasobamu, amaKhorigi,
noJowela noZebadiya, amadodana kaJerohamu waseGedori.

KwabakwaGadi bamhlukanisela uDavide endaweni yezintaba ngasehlane amadoda anamandla namadoda empi ahlomele ukulwa, aphatha isihlangu nesihlangu, ubuso bawo babunjengobuso bezingonyama, nanejubane njengenkemane ezintabeni;
u-Ezeri inhloko, u-Obadiya owesibili, u-Eliyabe owesithathu,
uMishimana owesine, uJeremiya owesihlanu,
u-Athayi owesithupha, u-Eliyeli owesikhombisa,
uJohanani owesishiyagalombili, u-Elisabadi owesishiyagalolunye,
uJeremiya owetshumi, uMagibanayi owetshumi lanye.
Laba babevela emadodaneni kaGadi, izinduna zempi;
Laba yibo abawela iJordani ngenyanga yokuqala liphuphuma lonke usebe lwalo; babalekela kuzo zonke izigodi, ngasempumalanga nasentshonalanga.
Kwafika nabanye babantwana bakwaBenjamini noJuda entabeni kanye noDavide.

UDavide waphuma ukubahlangabeza, waphendula, wathi kubo: “Uma niza kimi ngokuthula ukungisiza, inhliziyo yami iyonamathela kini; kepha uma niza ukungikhaphela ezitheni zami, njengokuba kungekho bubi esandleni sami, uNkulunkulu wawobaba uyakubheka, akusole.

Umoya wehlela phezu kuka-Amasayi owayeyinduna yezinduna, wathi: “Singakuwe, Davide, singakuwe, ndodana kaJese; ukuthula, ukuthula kube kuwe, nokuthula kubasizi bakho; ngoba uNkulunkulu wakho uyakusiza. UDavide wabamukela, wabenza abaholi beviyo.

Abanye bakwaManase bawela kuDavide ekufikeni kwakhe namaFilisti ukulwa noSawule; kodwa abazange babasize; ngokuba izikhulu zamaFilisti zameluleka ngokuthi: “Uyakuyibeka engozini uSawule inkosi yakhe.” zamakhanda ethu.
Esaya eSikilagi, u-Adina noJosabadi noJediyayeli noMikayeli noJosabadi no-Elihu noSilithayi, izinduna zezinkulungwane zakwaManase, bamhlasela.
Basebesiza uDavida phezu kweviyo, ngoba bonke babengamaqhawe alamandla lezinduna empini.
Ngokuba ngaleso sikhathi kwafika kuDavide imihla ngemihla ukumsiza, kwaze kwaba yibutho elikhulu njengempi kaNkulunkulu.
Lezi ziyizinombolo zamaviyo ayehlomele impi eza kuDavide eHebroni ukuze abuyisele ubukhosi bukaSawule kuye njengezwi likaJehova.
Abantwana bakwaJuda abaphatha isihlangu nomkhonto babeyizinkulungwane eziyisithupha namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, behlomele impi.
Kubantwana bakwaSimeyoni, amaqhawe anamandla empi, izinkulungwane eziyisikhombisa nekhulu.
Kubantwana bakwaLevi izinkulungwane ezine namakhulu ayisithupha;
UJehoyada wayengumholi woonyana baka-Aroni, enaye izinkulungwane ezintathu namakhulu ayisikhombisa;
noSadoki insizwa, iqhawe elinamandla, nasendlini kayise izinduna ezingamashumi amabili nambili.
Kubantwana bakwaBenjamini, umndeni kaSawule, izinkulungwane ezintathu; ngoba kuze kube manje iningi labo laliqaphe umlindi wendlu kaSawule.
Kubantwana bakwa-Efrayimi yizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, amaqhawe anamandla, abadumileyo ezindlini zawoyise.
Esiqingatheni sesizwe sakwaManase yizinkulungwane eziyishumi nesishiyagalombili, ababizwa ngamagama ukuba zize zibeke uDavide inkosi.
Kubantwana bakwa-Isakare, ababekwazi ukuqonda izikhathi, ukwazi okufanele u-Israyeli akwenze; amakhanda abo ayengamakhulu amabili; bonke abafowabo balandela umyalo wabo.
KwaZebuloni abaphuma impi, bengabakwazi ukulwa, benezikhali zonke zempi, izinkulungwane ezingamashumi ayisihlanu, abangaphuma impi; babengeyona impinda.
KwaNafetali izinduna eziyinkulungwane, kanye nazo eziyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amathathu nesikhombisa eziphethe isihlangu nomkhonto.
KumaDani ayesempini izinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nesishiyagalombili namakhulu ayisithupha.
Ku-Asheri, abaphuma impi, abahlomele ukulwa, izinkulungwane ezingamashumi amane.
Ngaphesheya kweJordani kwabakwaRubeni nabakwaGadi nasenxenyeni yesizwe sakwaManase benezikhali zonke zokulwa, izinkulungwane eziyikhulu namashumi amabili.
Onke lawo maqhawe anamandla okuhlela afika eHebroni ngenhliziyo epheleleyo ukubeka uDavide inkosi phezu kuka-Israyeli wonke; bonke abanye bakwa-Israyeli bavumelana ukumbeka uDavide inkosi.
Bahlala lapho noDavide izinsuku ezintathu, badla, baphuza, ngokuba abafowabo babebalungisele.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, labo ababeseduze nabo, kwaze kwaba kwa-Isakare, noZebuloni, nakwaNafetali, baletha isinkwa ngezimbongolo nangamakamela, neminyuzi, nezinkomo, nenyama, nempuphu, namaqebelengwane omkhiwane, nezigaxa zezithelo zomvini ezomisiweyo, newayini, namafutha, nezinkomo, nezinkomo; nenala, ngokuba kwakukhona intokozo kwa-Israyeli.
